title: Demo: Family Travel FAQ (Synthetic)
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT — not real operator policy.
content: Families planning in this demo assistant can search for sailings by occupancy including adults and children. Connecting staterooms and family-sized balcony cabins may be available on select sailings according to deterministic inventory counts. Youth programs and kids club hours vary by ship in the synthetic content library. For document requirements for minors, refer to the children travel documents policy. Family pricing is computed only through the deterministic pricing service with quote identifiers and freshness timestamps.
